title: RPSC APO Pre Exam Answer Key 2026

ageLimit: 21 to 40 years as on 01/07/2027. Age relaxation is applicable as per RPSC rules.
applicationFee: General / BC-OBC Creamy Layer / Other State: Rs. 600; BC / OBC / EWS: Rs. 400; SC / ST: Rs. 400; correction charge: Rs. 500. Pay through Rajasthan e-Mitra or online payment modes.
selectionProcess: Preliminary Examination -> Mains Examination -> Document Verification -> Final selection
documentsRequired: Registration details, admit card, valid identity proof, LLB certificate and marksheet, category certificate where applicable and other documents requested by RPSC.

shortDescription: RPSC Assistant Prosecution Officer APO Pre Exam Answer Key 2026 released on 07 September 2026. Download the official answer key for the 02 September 2026 preliminary exam.
content:
Rajasthan Public Service Commission (RPSC) has released the Assistant Prosecution Officer (APO) Pre Exam Answer Key 2026 for Advt. No. 03/Exam/APO/EP-1/2026-27.

The preliminary examination was held on 02 September 2026. Candidates can download the official answer key PDF and compare their responses. The recruitment covers 370 posts, including 355 Non-Scheduled Area and 15 Scheduled Area posts.

Important dates

  • Application begins: 08 June 2026
  • Last date to apply and pay fee: 07 July 2026
  • Preliminary exam: 02 September 2026
  • Pre exam answer key: 07 September 2026
  • Mains exam: 27 December 2026
  • Admit card: As per schedule / before exam
  • Result: As per schedule

How to download the answer key

  1. Open the official RPSC answer key link.
  2. Download the APO Pre Exam Answer Key PDF.
  3. Match answers with your question paper and calculate the expected score.
  4. Read the official notice for objection or representation instructions.
  5. Keep the PDF for mains preparation and future reference.

Read the official notification for complete eligibility, fee, age limit and selection details.
